ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible ventral surface exhibits a macro-level ratio of approximately 65% high-intensity (tan/white) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region at the peduncle junction extending toward the lobe centers. High-intensity areas are characterized by yellowish-tan pigmentation. Multiple dark, circular focal spots are mapped across both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the continuous boundary; right lobe trailing edge exhibits significant jaggedness with peak-to-valley amplitudes of up to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along the outer edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of several dark circular pixel clusters on the tan-colored regions; two distinct clusters on the right lobe and one on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular serration and probable tissue loss on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe; presence of distinct white linear scarring on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellow-brown pixel distribution across the high-intensity regions, consistent with uniform diatom/biofilm coverage.
